state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball. The robot stopped about 20–30 cm away, facing it, and is now resting.

- **Search:** I couldn't see the ball from the starting spot. I walked about 1.5 m forward, then turned toward the open part of the room. A look around from there showed the ball on the floor near a monitor stand, about 2 m away.
- **Getting there:** A black suitcase blocked the direct path, and the robot's collision protection stopped it twice. I backed up, went around the suitcase on the right, then walked straight to the ball. A small final turn put it dead ahead.
- **End state:** The robot said "I found the red ball", crouched and turned its motors off. When it crouched it turned slightly, so the ball now sits a little left of center, but it's still right in front.

There were no falls.
